paragraphs: The set top box became a small black square because everything else about it moved into software. What is left is a power socket, an HDMI port and a remote, and the remote is the only part anybody has an opinion about.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the devices as static pieces. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 the set suits product and technology visualisation, e-commerce and packaging imagery, living room and interior scenes, advertising, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

Augmented reality glasses have one design problem above all others: they have to be wearable in public. Everything about the optics, the weight and the arm thickness is a negotiation with the fact that people will not put on something that looks strange.
The model is light at 15,790 polygons and 8,009 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits product and technology visualisation, e-commerce imagery, advertising, workplace and concept scenes, film props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

Detergent packaging is designed around weight and shelf position. A large box has to be carried by a handle that cannot tear, stacked without collapsing, and read from three metres away in a badly lit aisle.
The model is extremely light at 3,187 polygons and 3,153 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits packaging and label mockups, retail and e-commerce imagery, product visualisation, advertising, utility room scenes and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The armet closed completely around the head, which made it the best protection ever built for a knight and the worst thing to be inside. Hinged cheek pieces let it be put on at all, and the visor was lifted at every opportunity.
The model is very light at 11,348 polygons and 11,640 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 16 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits character wardrobe work, game assets, historical and fantasy film costume, museum material, concept art and editorial illustration. On sale since 2017.

Basketball shorts got longer in one decade and never went back, which is one of the clearest examples of a sport's uniform being decided by its stars rather than by its rules. The cut is now the same everywhere from playgrounds up.
The garment is extremely light at 3,924 polygons and 3,914 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so it costs nothing on a character. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits apparel and sports visualisation, e-commerce imagery, character wardrobe work, advertising, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

A bagel is boiled before it is baked, and that is the only thing that makes it a bagel. The brief moment in water sets the crust, which is why the inside stays dense and why nothing shaped like one but baked straight is the same thing.
The model holds 44,904 polygons and 24,848 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits food and bakery visualisation, packaging and menu imagery, advertising, cafe and kitchen scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

The stitching on a baseball is the only reason the sport has pitching. Those raised seams are what let a thrown ball be made to curve, drop or rise, and everything else about the game grew out of that one property.
The model carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits sports and equipment visualisation, broadcast graphics, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2015.

A base is an anchored cushion that has to survive being slid into at speed and then let go if a runner catches a spike. The break away mounting underneath was one of the few genuine injury reductions the sport has adopted.
The model holds 22,395 polygons and 24,833 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in the smaller of the two sizes offered in the library. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits sports facility and equipment visualisation, broadcast graphics, field and stadium scenes, e-commerce imagery, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

Base size changed recently at the highest level, and the reason was arithmetic rather than tradition: a larger cushion shortens the distance between them by a few inches, which measurably increases stolen base attempts.
The model holds 22,395 polygons and 24,833 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in the larger of the two sizes offered in the library. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits sports facility and equipment visualisation, broadcast graphics, field and stadium scenes, e-commerce imagery, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

The tee removes the pitcher from the equation entirely, which is how every batter learns to swing and how professionals go back to fixing a fault. It is the most boring piece of equipment in the sport and the most used.
The model is supplied with the ball and carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits sports training and equipment visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, coaching material, advertising, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

A ball of wool is one of the harder ordinary objects to model convincingly, because the whole appearance is a single strand wound thousands of times. Faking it with a texture never survives a close shot.

The model holds 130,006 polygons and 200,008 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps, 3 at 4096x4096 and one at 1024x1024. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a second build is offered separately.
At $29 it suits craft and product visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, interior and decor scenes, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.

Bolt cutters are a lever problem solved twice. Two hinges in series multiply the hand force enormously, which is why a tool a person can carry will go through hardened steel and why the handles have to be so long.

The model is light at 18,189 polygons and 18,505 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in yellow, and comes rigged so the jaws can be posed or animated. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits tool and equipment visualisation, e-commerce imagery, workshop and site scenes, film and television props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

Boxing trunks sit high on the waist because the belt line is a rule: anything below it cannot be hit. The garment is therefore a piece of officiating equipment as much as clothing, and the cut has stayed the same for that reason.

The garment is extremely light at 1,938 polygons and 1,991 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits sports apparel visualisation, e-commerce imagery, character wardrobe work, broadcast graphics, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

Spirits sold by volume rather than by rarity are packaged differently: a lighter bottle, a simpler closure and a label designed to be read quickly in a busy shop. The economics of the category are visible in the glass itself.
The model is extremely light at 4,645 polygons and 4,601 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits beverage and packaging visualisation, label mockups, e-commerce and retail imagery, bar and interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.
